summary.score_interpretation: Relative ProtCross binding-site model score; not a calibrated probability or binding affinity.
summary.determinism_scope: canonical residue ordering and deterministic neighbor selection; floating-point reductions remain device and kernel dependent
summary.threshold_origin: user decision threshold; 0.5 is a neutral default, not an independently validated optimum
summary.annotated_structure_score_precision: PDB B-factor fields round to two decimal places; mmCIF uses up to six significant digits. Use scores.tsv or JSON for quantitative values.
summary.annotated_structure_preservation: PDB output preserves input records and patches only B-factor columns on ATOM/HETATM lines; mmCIF output preserves data categories while reserializing text.

input_interpretation.assembly: coordinates_as_supplied; biological assembly operators are not applied
input_interpretation.residue_basis: 20 standard ATOM amino-acid residues with a CA atom
input_interpretation.sequence_basis: coordinate-observed scorable residues, independently embedded per chain

summary.intended_use: Hypothesis generation and residue ranking for small-molecule-adjacent site analysis.
limitations: The 0.1.2 release checkpoint has not been established as a calibrated probability model.
Release labels use CA-within-6-Angstrom proximity to eligible hetero/nonstandard residue atoms after a name blacklist; they are not ligand-specific affinity labels.
The supplied coordinate assembly is used as-is; biological assembly operators are not applied.
Multiple selected chains share one geometry graph, and residue clusters can span chain interfaces.
Predicted-residue cluster centroids are not validated docking coordinates.

pockets.score_interpretation: Relative ProtCross binding-site model score. It is not a calibrated probability or a binding-affinity estimate.
pockets.determinism_scope: canonical residue ordering and deterministic neighbor selection; floating-point reductions remain device and kernel dependent
pockets.center_interpretation: Centroid of predicted residue CA coordinates; not a ligand centroid, cavity center, surface-accessible point, or validated docking-box center.
